story_log.title: Wyndham Clark wins second U.S. Open in wire-to-wire victory, survives antagonistic crowd and late push from Sam Burns
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Clark won U.S. Open by one stroke at Shinnecock Hills, leading wire-to-wire (first since 2014). Survived 6-shot lead nearly evaporating, crowd rooting against him all Sunday. Sam Burns charged to second place, Scheffler faded. Clark's father flew red-eye on Father's Day to surprise him on 18th green. Clark becomes fifth player to lead by multiple shots after all four rounds in U.S. Open history.

story_log.title: Brady Tkachuk traded to Panthers, reunites with brother Matthew after Ottawa sends captain south
story_log.development: Florida acquired Brady Tkachuk from Ottawa for two 2026 first-round picks, a future first, and a future second. Brothers reunited on Panthers roster after Brady orchestrated trade destination. Two-time Cup champion Panthers missed playoffs last season, adding rugged captain to retool.

story_log.title: Thunder trade Aaron Wiggins to Hawks for second-round picks, trim massive luxury tax penalty
story_log.development: Oklahoma City sent Wiggins (No. 55 pick 2021, developed into championship role player) to Atlanta for two second-round picks (Atlanta's 2030, least favorable of Hawks/Lakers 2032). Trade cuts Thunder's projected tax penalty from $213M to $152M. OKC now has two picks in top 17 of Tuesday's draft (Nos. 12 and 17).

story_log.title: Egypt earns first-ever World Cup win behind Mo Salah goal, beats New Zealand 3-1 after eight failed attempts
story_log.development: Egypt secured first World Cup win in history (0-8 all-time entering match) with 3-1 victory over New Zealand. Salah scored go-ahead goal, Trezeguet and Mostafa Ziko added insurance. Egypt trailed 1-0 early before storming back. Salah celebrated dancing in Vancouver streets surrounded by fans. Historic moment for Egyptian football after 52 years of futility.

story_log.title: Cape Verde earns second World Cup point with chaotic 2-2 draw vs Uruguay, scores first-ever goal on stunning free kick
story_log.development: Cape Verde (pop. 600K) scored first-ever World Cup goal (Kevin Pina free kick) and rallied twice to draw Uruguay 2-2. Hélio Varela equalized in 61st after Uruguay went up 2-1, then referee blew whistle during Cape Verde free kick in stoppage time, robbing them of potential winner. Tiny island nation now has 2 points from 2 games (drew Spain 0-0 in opener) and positioning for knockout round. Varela celebrated goal with basketball hesi tween move.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber leads MLB with 29 homers after three-homer night, Bryce Harper completes cycle in Phillies rout
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Schwarber hit three homers Sunday (29 on season, MLB lead) in 15-3 rout of Mets. Harper became 11th Phillies player to hit for cycle Saturday (9th in franchise history, first since 2024). Phillies scoring at will this weekend against New York.

story_log.title: Nneka Ogwumike hits game-winner at buzzer as Sparks complete 17-point comeback to beat Liberty in WNBA 30th anniversary game
story_log.development: Ogwumike's buzzer-beating three-pointer capped Sparks' 17-point comeback to beat Liberty 98-97 in rematch of WNBA's inaugural game from 1997. Ogwumike finished with 24 PTS, 6 REB, 3 STL on 11-18 FG. Liberty led most of the way before LA stormed back. Emotional night celebrating 30 years of WNBA.

story_log.title: Spain routs Saudi Arabia 4-0 as 17-year-old Lamine Yamal scores first World Cup goal, Japan demolishes Tunisia 4-0
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 8]: Spain crushed Saudi Arabia 4-0 with Yamal (17) scoring first WC goal. Japan beat Tunisia 4-0. Iran and Belgium drew 0-0 after Iran left handwritten 'peace' note in SoFi Stadium dressing room. Group stage rolling.

story_log.title: CJ McCollum signs one-year, $21M extension to stay with Hawks through 2027
story_log.development: McCollum extended one year, $21M (plus trade kicker) with Atlanta per Shams. Hawks went 19-4 with him as starter from Feb. 22 through end of season. Closed 11th straight year with 150+ threes (tied 4th-most such campaigns in NBA history). Signed through next season, avoiding free agency.

story_log.title: Jordan Goodwin returns to Suns on 3-year, $19M deal after culture-fit breakout season
story_log.development: Goodwin (made roster on non-guaranteed deal) signed 3-year, $19M with player option in Year 3 to return to Phoenix per Shams. Averaged 8.7 PPG, 4.9 RPG, 2.2 APG, team-high 106 steals. Suns locking up young guards (Goodwin and Collin Gillespie) after developmental success.

story_log.title: Colby Thomas robs homer with catch-of-the-year candidate, A's beat Angels
story_log.development: Thomas made ridiculous leaping catch at wall to rob homer vs Angels. SportsCenter, Jomboy, SleeperHQ all called it catch-of-the-year candidate. A's beat Angels 9-7 after trailing 4-0 early. Zach Neto delivered go-ahead hit for LA in 9th but Oakland rallied.

story_log.title: Rafael Devers tries to reject pinch-runner in ninth inning as tying run, Giants manager says 'you know how competitive he is'
story_log.development: Devers didn't want to be pulled for pinch-runner as tying run in ninth inning vs Marlins. Jomboy breakdown captured exchange. Giants manager Tony Vitello: 'You know how competitive he is.' Marlins won 2-1.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani announces birth of second child, homers in loss to Orioles after returning from paternity leave
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Ohtani announced second child born on social media, returned from paternity list and homered same day. Dodgers lost to Orioles 12-1 (Baltimore crushed LA). Ohtani back, but Dodgers blown out.

story_log.title: North Carolina forces Game 3 in College World Series Finals with 6-2 win over Oklahoma, winner-take-all Monday
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: UNC beat Oklahoma 6-2 in Game 2 to force winner-take-all Game 3 Monday. Caden Glauber (18) threw masterclass: 5 IP, 1 H, 8 K. Tar Heels even series 1-1. National championship on the line Monday in Omaha.

story_log.title: Serena Williams granted wild card to play singles at Wimbledon, also teaming with Venus in doubles
story_log.development: Serena received wild card to play singles at Wimbledon per ESPN, also returning to play doubles with Venus. Comeback extends to second Grand Slam. Major story for tennis as Williams returns to grass courts.

story_log.title: Royals' Jac Caglianone hits two homers vs Cardinals, first Royal with 2 HR/3 RBI/2 BB game since 2019
story_log.development: Caglianone went 2-3 with 2 HR, 3 RBI, 2 BB vs Cardinals. First Royals player with that line in a game since 2019 per StatMuse. Kansas City lost 12-10 but Caglianone continuing to Figure It Out per CespedesBBQ. Royals and Cardinals honored Negro Leagues with special hats.

story_log.title: Orioles demolish Dodgers 12-1 behind Pete Alonso homer, Baltimore clobbers LA
story_log.development: Baltimore crushed Dodgers 12-1. Alonso went oppo for homer. TalkinBaseball: 'Orioles are clobbering the Dodgers 10-1.' O's dominated from start to finish. LA blown out at home.

story_log.title: Justin Verlander likely out 'weeks' with hamstring strain, hints at retirement: 'maybe the wheels are falling off'
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Verlander has left hamstring strain, likely out 'weeks' per Tigers manager A.J. Hinch. Verlander conceded 'maybe the wheels are falling off' after latest injury. Retirement speculation intensifying for 43-year-old future Hall of Famer.

story_log.title: AL home run leader Yordan Alvarez declines Home Run Derby invitation
story_log.development: Alvarez (25 HR, second in MLB) will not participate in Home Run Derby per Chandler Rome. TalkinBaseball reported decline. Derby field shrinking as sluggers pass.

story_log.title: Kyle Schwarber hits three homers, Bryce Harper completes first career cycle in same game as Phillies demolish Mets 15-3
story_log.development: Schwarber hit three home runs (5th career 3-HR game, most in Phillies history with 4), Harper completed first career cycle (9th in Phillies history, first since 2024), Phillies beat Mets 15-3. Harper's cycle came in first five innings, fastest since Adrian Beltre 2015.

story_log.title: Wyndham Clark takes 6-shot lead into final round of U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills, Scottie Scheffler lurking
story_log.development: Round 3: Clark shot even-par 70 to extend lead to 6 shots heading into Sunday. Scheffler six back in final pairing, has chance at career grand slam. Clark's 6-shot lead is third-largest after 54 holes in U.S. Open history (behind Rory 2011, Tiger 2000).

story_log.title: Netherlands demolish Sweden 5-1 to break World Cup record, Curaçao goalkeeper Eloy Room ties Tim Howard save record in historic draw
story_log.development: Netherlands beat Sweden 5-1, broke tournament record per ESPN. Curaçao goalkeeper Eloy Room made 15 saves (tied Tim Howard's WC record) to earn 0-0 draw vs Ecuador, first-ever World Cup point for island nation (pop. 600K). Germany beat Ivory Coast 2-1 after Deniz Undav scored twice as super sub.

story_log.title: Byron Buxton grand slam keys Twins' 10-run fifth inning, Minnesota crushes Diamondbacks 16-8
story_log.development: Buxton hit grand slam in 10-run fifth inning as Twins beat Diamondbacks 16-8. Minnesota led 16-0 before fifth inning ended. Freddy Peralta allowed career-high 10 ER for Brewers (2.2 IP).

story_log.title: Travis Bazzana goes 4-4 with two homers, surpasses Brice Turang for highest wRC+ among all MLB second basemen
story_log.development: Bazzana (No. 1 pick) went 4-4 with 2 HR vs opponent, wRC+ now 136 (tops among all 2B min. 150 PA, passing Turang). Guardians won 8-1 over Astros.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani returns from paternity leave, homers in Dodgers' 2-3 loss to Orioles after announcing second child
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Ohtani announced second child born Saturday, returned from paternity list and immediately homered in 3-2 loss to Baltimore. Dodgers lose close game.

story_log.title: Reds demolish Yankees 10-2 behind offensive explosion
story_log.development: Cincinnati crushed Yankees 10-2. New York's offense went silent after recent hot stretch.

story_log.title: Pirates tie game in ninth only to have umpires convene and rule baserunner interference, ending game
story_log.development: Pittsburgh tied game until umps got together and ruled baserunner interference, which ended game. Jomboy breakdown shows runner hit fielder's glove. Pirates have lost seven straight with Skenes starting.

story_log.title: Kelsey Mitchell ankle breaker sends opponent to floor, Fever beat Dream
story_log.development: Mitchell hit defender with ankle breaker and drained three vs Dream. Indiana beat Atlanta. ESPN and HaterReport highlighted crossover.

story_log.title: Wings explode for 36 fourth-quarter points to rally from 15 down and stun Sky 93-92
story_log.development: Dallas scored season-high 36 points in fourth quarter to rally from 15-point deficit and beat Chicago 93-92. Wings caught fire late.

story_log.title: Angel Reese becomes fastest player in WNBA history to reach 1,000 career rebounds
story_log.development: Reese reached 1,000 rebounds faster than any player in WNBA history. Dream lost to Fever 96-113. ESPN highlighted milestone.

story_log.title: Oklahoma one win from national championship after blowout Game 1 win over North Carolina
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Oklahoma beat UNC in Game 1 of CWS Finals. Deiten Lachance hit two homers. Sooners one win from title. Game 2 Sunday.

story_log.title: Titans sign DT Jeffery Simmons to $105M+ extension
story_log.development: Tennessee extended Simmons 3 years, $105.8M per Schefter and Rapoport. Massive deal for Titans defensive anchor.

story_log.title: Collin Gillespie returns to Suns on 4-year, $48M deal after breakout campaign
story_log.development: Gillespie (undrafted 2022, three straight two-way deals) signing 4-year, $48M to return to Phoenix per Shams. Set Suns franchise record with 232 threes last season, averaged 12.7 PPG.

story_log.title: USMNT wins Group D for first time since 2010, advances to knockout stage after 2-0 shutout of Australia
story_log.development: Game 2: USA beat Australia 2-0 in Seattle (Balogun forced own goal, Freeman header after VAR review). First shutout since September. First time winning group stage since 2010. Paraguay's 1-0 win over Turkey gave USA first place in Group D. Advance to Round of 32.

story_log.title: Titans DT Jeffery Simmons becomes highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history with $100M guaranteed extension
story_log.development: Tennessee extended Simmons 3 years, $35.3M per year, $100M guaranteed. First DT ever with $100M guaranteed. Highest-paid DT in NFL history, surpassing Chris Jones ($31.75M/yr).

story_log.title: Dodgers walk off Orioles after catcher's throw gets away in 9th inning
story_log.development: LA scored three runs in 9th to walk off Baltimore 6-5. Winning run scored when throw to plate got away. Dodgers rally from behind to beat O's.

story_log.title: Athletics rally from 11-4 deficit to walk off Angels 12-11, Nick Kurtz draws walk-off walk
story_log.development: A's trailed 11-4, rallied to tie it. Jonah Heim hit 2-run homer with Oakland down to final out. Nick Kurtz drew walk-off walk in extras. Oakland's improbable comeback win in Vegas.

story_log.title: Marina Mabrey ties WNBA record with 9 threes, drops career-high 37 points in Tempo comeback win over Sun
story_log.development: Mabrey posted 37 PTS (career-high), 9-12 3PT (ties WNBA single-game record), 21 points in fourth quarter alone. Toronto Tempo beat Connecticut 101-97 after trailing late.

story_log.title: Yankees' Cam Schlittler strikes out 13 in dominant start, continues breakout rookie season
story_log.development: Schlittler: career-high 13 SO vs Cincinnati. Now 8-3 with 1.71 ERA, lowest in AL this season. Yankees phenom rolling.

story_log.title: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong hits homer in third straight game, posts historic 18-game run
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 4]: PCA homered vs Blue Jays, third straight game with HR. Over last 18 games: 34 H, 5 2B, 2 3B, 9 HR, 6 SB — no player in MLB modern era has ever posted those numbers in any 18-game span.

story_log.title: Paraguay beats Turkey 1-0 playing entire second half with 10 men, Turkey eliminated from World Cup
story_log.development: Paraguay scored in first 64 seconds, then Miguel Almirón got red card for covering mouth while talking to Turkish player (first enforcement of Prestianni Rule). Paraguay held on with 10 men entire second half to win 1-0. Turkey dominated possession but lost, eliminated from World Cup.

story_log.title: Brazil beats Haiti 3-0 as Matheus Cunha scores brace, Raphinha exits with injury
story_log.development: Cunha scored twice, Vini Jr added goal as Brazil cruised 3-0 over Haiti. Raphinha left match with non-contact injury, clouds Brazil's WC outlook. Endrick nearly scored first WC goal but was ruled offside.

story_log.title: Tigers ace Justin Verlander hints at retirement after latest injury: 'Maybe the wheels are falling off'
story_log.development: Verlander said after latest injury 'It's a different conversation now' and conceded 'maybe the wheels are falling off.' Has wanted to play until wheels fall off. Retirement speculation growing.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani placed on paternity list, out of Dodgers lineup as baby arrives
story_log.development: Ohtani placed on paternity leave, expected to return over weekend. Baby Ohtani incoming. First child for Dodgers star.

story_log.title: Zack Gelof hit in head with fastball but stays in game for Athletics
story_log.development: Gelof took fastball directly to head during A's-Angels game, but is okay and stayed in. Scary moment in Vegas.

story_log.title: A's manager Mark Kotsay ejected for arguing balls and strikes, hot mic catches every word
story_log.development: Kotsay tossed for arguing balls/strikes with umpire, hot mic captured entire exchange. Jomboy breakdown.

story_log.title: Tarik Skubal gets in screaming match with White Sox dugout after escaping bases-loaded jam
story_log.development: Skubal struck out side with bases loaded, then got in screaming match with Chicago dugout. Jomboy breakdown captured exchange. Tigers won.

story_log.title: Ranger Suarez no-hit bid broken in 7th inning by Josh Naylor double
story_log.development: Suarez carried no-hitter into 7th vs Guardians before Naylor ripped double in gap to end bid. Phillies still won.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll goes single, double, triple, walk vs Twins — homer shy of cycle
story_log.development: Carroll: 1 1B, 1 2B, 1 3B, 1 BB, 4 RBI vs Minnesota. One homer shy of cycle. Diamondbacks star almost completes rare feat.

story_log.title: Jeremy Pena hits first multi-homer game of season for Astros
story_log.development: Pena went deep twice vs opponent, first multi-HR game of 2026 season. Houston shortstop breaks out.

story_log.title: Padres' Ty France posts second 2-HR, 5-RBI game of season and loses again
story_log.development: France: 2 HR, 5 RBI vs Rangers (tied game with second homer off Jacob deGrom). Padres lost anyway. France and Manny Machado both have 2 HR/5 RBI games this year that ended in losses.

story_log.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope exercises $21.6M player option to stay with Grizzlies
story_log.development: KCP exercised $21.6M player option for 2026-27 season per Shams. Staying in Memphis.

story_log.title: ESPN's Kendrick Perkins becomes Jackson State men's basketball GM while keeping analyst role
story_log.development: Perkins agreed to become Jackson State's men's basketball GM while continuing ESPN role. Latest retired NBA player to take admin position in college hoops (joins John Wall at Howard, Steph at Davidson, Trae at Oklahoma).

story_log.title: Knicks championship parade draws over 2 million fans, delivers chaos and viral moments
story_log.development: Championship parade Thursday drew 2+ million to NYC streets. Tyler Kolek mistaken for fan and detained by NYPD. Fan passed out, woman saved him, he tried to kiss her. Josh Hart's wife stuck her thumb up his butt. Carmelo Anthony: 'I helped build this. A ring would be appreciated.' Wemby heckled. Timothée Chalamet on float. Alicia Keys performed. Parade generated insane viral moments.

story_log.title: Andrew Benintendi pinch-hit grand slam lifts White Sox over Yankees 5-1, first 4-run loss of season for NY
story_log.development: White Sox beat Yankees 5-1. Benintendi crushed pinch-hit grand slam to break open game. First time all season Yankees lost by 4+ runs. Jazz Chisholm Jr. left game after fouling ball off manhood. Chicago rolling, Yankees shocked.

story_log.title: Mexico tops Group A for first time since 2002 after Luis Romo goal sinks South Korea 1-0
story_log.development: Mexico beat South Korea 1-0 in Guadalajara. Luis Romo scored lone goal. SK goalkeeper blunder led to goal, internet roasted keeper. Mexico finishes first in Group A for first time since 2002. Huge result for El Tri at home.

story_log.title: Canada demolishes Qatar 6-0, Jonathan David hat trick sparks Golden Boot race
story_log.development: Canada destroyed Qatar 6-0. Jonathan David scored hat trick. Nathan Saliba scored sensational free kick minutes after coming on for injured Ismaël Koné, threw up No. 8 and jersey for brother. Brawl nearly broke out after Koné's broken leg. Canada cruises, Qatar humiliated.

story_log.title: Angel Reese picks up first regular-season win vs Caitlin Clark behind 21-11 performance
story_log.development: Reese posted 21 PTS, 11 REB, 8-14 FG as Dream beat Fever 108-101 on road. Clark had 26 PTS, 7 AST, 8-17 FG. Reese mocked Clark for foul baiting during game. First time Reese has beaten Clark in regular season since rookie year.

story_log.title: Mike Trout to injured list with hamstring strain, could miss All-Star Game in Philadelphia
story_log.development: Angels placed Trout on 10-day IL with right hamstring strain. Having resurgent season at 34, All-Star level production. May miss All-Star Game in Philly. Latest injury setback for Trout.

story_log.title: MLB proposes removing high school players from draft, cutting rounds from 20 to 12
story_log.development: MLB proposed eliminating high school eligibility from draft, making college players eligible after sophomore year, shortening draft from 20 to 12 rounds, cutting bonus pool from $358.7M to $200M. Also proposed international draft. Major CBA proposal from league.

story_log.title: Braves acquire catcher Joey Bart from Pirates
story_log.development: Atlanta acquired Bart from Pittsburgh per TalkinBaseball. Former top prospect joins Braves. Trade made during World Cup day.

story_log.title: Salvador Perez passes George Brett for most home runs at Kauffman Stadium with No. 137
story_log.development: Perez hit 137th career homer at Kauffman Stadium, passing Brett for most all-time at their home ballpark. Royals milestone for franchise icon.

story_log.title: Bobby Witt Jr. exits game after appearing to hurt right leg, pinch-hit for immediately
story_log.development: Witt left game vs Cardinals after appearing to hurt right leg. Initially stayed in but was pinch-hit for in bottom of inning. Royals monitoring superstar.

story_log.title: Juan Soto hits two home runs vs White Sox, Yankees fall 5-1
story_log.development: Soto hit two homers (one way gone, one in 7th) vs Chicago. Yankees lost 5-1 after Benintendi's grand slam. Soto provided offense, wasn't enough.

story_log.title: NHL clears Mike Babcock to coach again, opening path for Oilers to hire him
story_log.development: NHL announced Babcock is clear to coach after investigation into Columbus resignation in Sept 2023. Edmonton can now hire him. League investigation complete.

story_log.title: MLB announces new HR Derby format: 8 participants, 20 swings Round 1, 15 swings final rounds
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: MLB announced 2026 format changes: 8 participants, top 4 advance. 20 swings in Round 1, 15 in final two rounds. Player who homers on last swing continues until out or wins round.

story_log.title: Adley Rutschman hit in helmet by throw in ninth inning vs Mariners
story_log.development: Rutschman got hit in helmet by throw in 9th inning of Orioles-Mariners game. Seattle won 3-0. Extent of injury unclear.

story_log.title: Trea Turner exits Phillies game after hit-by-pitch on knee
story_log.development: Turner left game after getting hit by pitch on knee. Phillies concern after awkward HBP. Status unclear.

story_log.title: James Dolan tells WFAN he won't go into punitive second apron to keep Knicks intact
story_log.development: Dolan told WFAN Wednesday he will not go into punitive second apron to keep team intact for 2026-27 season. Championship glow may not prevent roster cuts.

story_log.title: Isiah Thomas questions NBA crowning Wembanyama as face of league, compares to Jordan treatment in Detroit era
story_log.development: Thomas reflected on never being league's face despite Pistons beating Bird, Magic, Jordan. Sees similar dynamic with Wemby: league choosing face isn't always about who wins most. ClutchPoints deep dive on Thomas's comments.

story_log.title: Ghana scores last-gasp winner vs Panama in 2026 World Cup group stage
story_log.development: Caleb Yirenkyi scored winner in 95th minute to give Ghana 1-0 win over Panama after 0-0 stalemate. Ghana's second World Cup win ever, first since 2010.

story_log.title: England routs Croatia 4-2 in World Cup opener behind Kane brace and Rashford strike
story_log.development: England beat Croatia 4-2 in Group L opener. Harry Kane scored twice, Marcus Rashford added late goal. Croatia led 2-0 early, England stormed back with 4 unanswered. Bellingham goal gave England lead in second half.

story_log.title: DR Congo earns first-ever World Cup point with 1-1 draw vs Portugal
story_log.development: Congo scored first World Cup goal in 52 years (since 1974 appearance) and held Portugal to 1-1 draw. Ronaldo went 90 minutes without goal, 0 shots on target, 0 assists, 1,000 minutes since last non-penalty WC/Euro goal. Thierry Henry cooked Ronaldo postgame.

story_log.title: Olivia Miles explodes for career-high 31 points on 80% shooting vs Sparks
story_log.development: Miles posted 31 PTS (career-high), 4 REB, 4 AST on 12-15 FG (80%). Only rookie this century besides Paige Bueckers with 30+ on 80+ FG%. Had 24 points in first half alone. Lynx beat Sparks.

story_log.title: Trae Young declines $49M player option, will negotiate extension with Wizards
story_log.development: Young plans to decline $48.97M player option to become FA Monday, per Marc Spears. Washington remains front runner, Young loves team and DC. Expects multiple team max interest. Will negotiate long-term extension.

story_log.title: Passan releases top 100 MLB trade deadline candidates: Skubal, Chapman, Peralta lead market
story_log.development: Jeff Passan and Kiley McDaniel published top 100 trade candidates ahead of Aug. 3 deadline. Tarik Skubal, Matt Chapman, David Peralta, Luis Arraez headlining. Will update list periodically as deadline approaches.

story_log.title: North Carolina and Oklahoma advance to College World Series Finals
story_log.development: UNC eliminated West Virginia to reach CWS Finals for first time since 2007. Oklahoma beat Georgia to advance. Best-of-3 championship series begins Saturday in Omaha.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong homers in third consecutive game for surging Cubs
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: PCA hit leadoff homer vs Rockies, third straight game with HR. Cubs offense rolling after cycle performance two days ago.

story_log.title: Devin Booker switches from No. 1 to No. 15, honoring father and Team USA
story_log.development: Booker changing jersey number from 1 to 15 next season per Shams. Honors USA Basketball uniform and father Melvin Booker's college number. Ends 11-year run in No. 1.

story_log.title: Corbin Carroll hits go-ahead grand slam to put Diamondbacks in front vs Angels
story_log.development: Carroll crushed go-ahead grand slam in late innings as Diamondbacks rallied vs Angels. Arizona won 8-1.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson passes Brittney Griner on all-time WNBA scoring list, fastest to 6,000 points
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 6]: Wilson posted 33 PTS, 11 REB, 5 STL, 2 BLK vs Phoenix. Only player in WNBA history to record those numbers in single game. Reached 6K points in just 278 games, fastest ever. Chelsea Gray tied WNBA single-game three-point record with 9 threes same night.

story_log.title: Sabrina Ionescu hits clutch go-ahead bucket to give Liberty win over Sky
story_log.development: Ionescu hit late go-ahead shot as Liberty edged Sky 96-95. New York wins close game to improve record.

story_log.title: Sonia Citron posts first 20/10 game of season (26-12) as Mystics beat Sun
story_log.development: Citron had 26 PTS, 12 REB, 4 AST, 12-12 FT in Mystics' 88-81 win over Connecticut. First 20/10 game of her season.

story_log.title: Royals acquire Randy Dobnak from Mariners after exercising upward-mobility clause
story_log.development: Kansas City acquired RHP Randy Dobnak from Seattle per Passan. Dobnak exercised upward-mobility clause in contract, added to 40-man roster. Will start at Triple-A Omaha.

story_log.title: MLB removes clock from Home Run Derby, switches to 20 swings first round / 15 swings final two
story_log.development: MLB getting rid of clock in Home Run Derby per Evan Drellich. Participants get 20 swings in first round, 15 in final two rounds. On last pitch of each round, keep going until they don't hit homer.

story_log.title: NBA champions Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson throw out first pitch at Yankees game
story_log.development: Knicks champions Hart and Brunson threw ceremonial first pitch at Yankee Stadium. ESPN and Jomboy Media covered moment.

story_log.title: Knicks championship parade draws massive crowds at 4am, 6 hours before start
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 11]: Knicks fans lined streets at 4am, six hours before championship parade scheduled to start. Crowd scenes went viral. HaterReport: 'Knicks fans been waiting for this their WHOLE LIVES.'

story_log.title: Olympic medalist Jenny Simpson collapses after medical episode while pacing mile group
story_log.development: Simpson collapsed after suffering medical episode while pacing mile group at event in Raleigh, NC on Tuesday per ESPN. Olympic bronze medalist and world-champion 1,500m runner. Condition unknown.

story_log.title: Golden Knights promote Ryan Craig from AHL affiliate to replace John Tortorella as head coach
story_log.development: Vegas promoted Ryan Craig (AHL affiliate coach) to lead NHL team as head coach per ESPN. Moved on from Tortorella day earlier. Quick coaching change for Knights.

story_log.title: Maple Leafs hire Jim Hiller as head coach after 93-58-24 record with Kings
story_log.development: Toronto hired Hiller as head coach per ESPN. 93-58-24 record over parts of three seasons with LA Kings. Second stint with Leafs (worked as assistant 2015-19). Hiller is 57 years old.

story_log.title: Lionel Messi ties World Cup goal record with hat trick vs Algeria at age 38, first-ever WC hat trick in his career
story_log.development: Messi scored three goals in Argentina's 3-0 win over Algeria, tying Miroslav Klose for most career World Cup goals with 16. First World Cup hat trick of Messi's career. Oldest Argentine player to score in WC history.

story_log.title: Mbappe becomes France's all-time leading scorer, Haaland scores twice in World Cup debuts
story_log.development: Mbappe scored twice to become France's all-time leading goalscorer in 3-1 win vs Senegal. Haaland scored two goals in World Cup debut for Norway (4-1 win vs Iraq). Both dominated on same day.

story_log.title: Austria survives VAR controversy and Jordan's first-ever World Cup goal to win 3-1
story_log.development: Austria had goal disallowed for handball after VAR review, then scored own-goal minutes later. Jordan scored first-ever World Cup goal (Ali Olwan). Austria won 3-1 with Arnautović penalty in stoppage time.

story_log.title: Yankees demolish White Sox 12-2 behind Ben Rice's 20th homer, Davis Martin's ERA balloons from 2.41 to 3.31
story_log.development: Yankees crushed White Sox 12-2. Ben Rice hit 20th homer. Davis Martin (2.41 ERA entering game, second-best in AL) allowed 9 runs and 3 homers in 3.1 innings, ERA now 3.31.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong follows cycle with leadoff homer the next day, Cubs rolling
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: PCA hit leadoff homer against Rockies day after completing cycle in reverse order and getting picked off first base. Cubs offense clicking.

story_log.title: West Virginia eliminates Troy 6-0 with shutout, sings Country Roads in Omaha again
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 4]: WVU shut out Troy 6-0 in elimination game at MCWS. Entire stadium sang Country Roads. Mountaineers advancing after first-ever CWS appearance.

story_log.title: Georgia eliminates Texas from College World Series with shutout pitching performance
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 5]: Georgia shut out Texas to eliminate Longhorns from MCWS. Bulldogs' pitching dominance sends Texas home. Georgia advancing in Omaha.

story_log.title: Brendan Sorsby officially enters NFL Supplemental Draft after withdrawing lawsuit, draft set for late July
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Sorsby formally filed paperwork to enter Supplemental Draft per Pelissero. Legal team withdrawing lawsuit Tuesday. Application deadline June 22, draft late July, Pro Day window July 5-12. Teams evaluating first-round talent QB.

story_log.title: Nationals beat Royals 6-4, tied for wild card spot with hardest schedule in baseball
story_log.development: Washington beat Kansas City 6-4. PFT: Nationals tied for wild card spot, have played hardest schedule in MLB, scored most runs in baseball. Offense electric.

story_log.title: George Springer hits 300th career home run for Blue Jays vs Red Sox
story_log.development: Springer launched 300th career homer in Toronto's 6-1 win over Boston. Milestone blast for veteran outfielder.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani breaks scoreless tie with solo homer vs Rays in Dodgers' 1-0 win
story_log.development: Ohtani hit go-ahead solo homer in 7th inning as Dodgers beat Rays 1-0. Justin Wrobleski threw 6.0 shutout innings (2.51 ERA in 12 starts).

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark posts 21-14 assist game, extends WNBA record for 20/10a games as Fever crush Toronto Tempo
story_log.development: Clark posted 21 pts, 14 ast vs Toronto (113-91 Fever win). Extended WNBA all-time record for 20/10a games. Sophie Cunningham added 24 pts on 8-11 FG.

story_log.title: Broncos QB Bo Nix undergoes second ankle surgery to clean out bone spurs, on track for training camp
story_log.development: Nix had additional ankle surgery to remove bone spurs per Schefter. On track to be ready for training camp. Minor setback for Denver QB.

story_log.title: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with hamstring injury, expects to be ready for training camp
story_log.development: McConkey has been dealing with hamstring injury this offseason per Schefter. Expects to be ready for training camp. Chargers monitoring rookie WR.

story_log.title: Eight-time Pro Bowl DE Cam Jordan returns to Saints on one-year deal
story_log.development: Jordan re-signed with New Orleans on one-year, incentive-laden deal per Rapoport and Schefter. Franchise great back in black and gold.

story_log.title: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice released from Dallas County jail after serving 30-day sentence
story_log.development: Rice released from jail Tuesday after serving 30 days for probation violation per Schefter. Avoided reporters. Knee recovery continues.

story_log.title: Vikings hire former Bears GM Ryan Pace as football advisor, add ex-Seahawks exec as assistant director of pro scouting
story_log.development: Minnesota hired Pace as football advisor and Azzaam Kapadia as assistant director of pro scouting per Seifert. Nolan Teasley building out staff.

story_log.title: NBA Finals Game 5 delivers 24.5M viewers, most-watched Finals since 1998
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 10]: ABC and ESPN scored most-watched NBA Finals since 1998 per Nielsen. Game 5 averaged 24.5M viewers, peaked at 33M watching Knicks clinch championship. Most-watched Finals Game 5 since 1998.

story_log.title: George Pickens addresses contract drama, says he won't hold out and will be at training camp
story_log.development: Pickens told reporters he's not disappointed he didn't get long-term deal, won't hold out, will be at training camp. Skipped OTAs on agent's advice. 'What's important to me is winning.'

story_log.title: Sixers hire Mike Gansey as president of basketball operations, already bringing bad juju with 'no-hitter' comment
story_log.development: Philadelphia hired Gansey as president of basketball operations. Jomboy: Gansey said 'no hitter still intact' and immediately jinxed team.

story_log.title: Ohio State lands reclassifying five-star LJ Smith, returns to preseason Top 25 after recruiting coup
story_log.development: Smith (No. 28 recruit in Class of 2027) reclassified to enroll early at Ohio State. Buckeyes back in preseason Top 25 And 1 per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: USMNT's Christian Pulisic trains individually for second day in a row as Australia match nears
story_log.development: Pulisic trained individually for second straight day with calf issue per CBS Sports. Exited Paraguay opener at halftime. Team describes as minor. Australia match Friday.

story_log.title: Islam Makhachev and Paddy Pimblett mock Ilia Topuria after loss to Justin Gaethje at UFC Freedom 250
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Topuria broke silence after Gaethje loss. Makhachev and Pimblett mocked former champion after UFC Freedom 250 defeat.

story_log.title: Texas Tech QB Brendan Sorsby enters NFL Supplemental Draft, ending college eligibility fight
story_log.development: Sorsby plans to enter NFL Supplemental Draft per Thamel and Pelissero. Legal fight over NCAA eligibility ends. Sorsby's attorneys withdrawing lawsuit Tuesday. Regarded as first-round talent, could be highest-drafted supplemental pick in decades. Deadline June 22 to apply, late July draft. Pro Day window July 5-12. AlbertBreer timeline and analysis.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits for the cycle in reverse order, then immediately gets picked off first base
story_log.development: PCA completed cycle (HR, 3B, 2B, 1B in that order) vs Rockies, then got picked off first base before next pitch. Jomboy breakdown: 'completes the cycle and gets picked off before the next pitch.' Cubs walked off later after wild inning. BarstoolBigCat: 'PCA hitting for the cycle only to give the haters some red meat by getting picked off is just perfect.' Second cycle in PCA's career. Cubs won 5-4.

story_log.title: Dustin May throws complete-game one-hitter on 96 pitches, second CG shutout in four days
story_log.development: May threw 9.0 IP, 1 H, 0 R, 1 BB, 9 SO on just 96 pitches vs Padres (complete-game one-hitter, Maddux territory). Perfect through six innings (Tatis walk broke it), Machado single in seventh broke no-no. StatMuse: second pitcher with 9+ IP and 1 hit in a game in the last 4 days (Misiorowski threw one-hitter Friday). Dodgers beat Padres 3-0. May hit 103.7 mph in 9th inning.

story_log.title: World Cup produces historic day: four draws in one calendar day for only the second time ever (first since 1958)
story_log.development: Four draws today (only second time in WC history with 4 draws on one calendar day, first since June 15, 1958): Cape Verde 0-0 Spain (historic upset), Belgium 1-1 Egypt (Lukaku scored 4 seconds after subbing on, instant own goal followed), France-Senegal ended in draw, Saudi Arabia-Uruguay ended in draw. BetweenTheNums: 'Today is the first time there have been 3+ draws on a single day in FIFA World Cup history since June 28, 1994!' PFT and Big Cat: 'What a day for Draws! Soccer is the best sport ever when you bet every game to end in a Tie!'

story_log.title: Cape Verde (pop. 600K) holds Spain to scoreless draw in World Cup, one of greatest upsets in tournament history
story_log.development: Cape Verde earned first-ever World Cup point with 0-0 draw vs European champions Spain. 40-year-old electrician goalkeeper 'Vozinha' stood on head (Spain had 20+ shots). Tiny island nation (pop. 600K, GDP less than Big Ten athletics depts combined) parked bus and survived. Yamal subbed on, couldn't score. Fans invaded Atlanta concourse after result. SharpFootball: 'CAPE VERDE ON TOP OF THE WORLD!!' MenInBlazers: 'A heroic effort from the third-smallest nation ever to reach a World Cup, with a smaller population than Wyoming 🤯 Imagine not loving football.' RedditCFB: entire population could fit in 5 SEC stadiums.

story_log.title: Colt Keith hits three home runs in one game, Tigers demolish Astros 9-3
story_log.development: Keith went deep three times vs Houston (9-3 Detroit win). TalkinBaseball: 'THREE-HOMER NIGHT FOR COLT KEITH!' ClutchPoints: 'COLT KEITH SMASHES HIS THIRD HOME RUN OF THE GAME 🤯' Tigers young hitter with career night.

story_log.title: Bulls hire Tiago Splitter as head coach, luring him away from Blazers after playoff run
story_log.development: Chicago finalized hire of Splitter as head coach per Shams. Splitter led Blazers to 42-40 record and No. 7 seed as interim after Chauncey Billups' federal charges. Bulls landed on Splitter for player development ability, organizational alignment, leadership. 41-year-old former Spurs champion succeeds Billy Donovan. Met with four finalists: Splitter, Micah Nori, Ryan Schmidt, Wes Unseld Jr.

story_log.title: Wizards center Alex Sarr undergoes surgery for fractured right foot, expected healthy for season opener
story_log.development: Sarr had surgery Monday to repair fractured right foot per Shams. Injury sustained on contact play during offseason workout late last week. Expected healthy for start of season. Washington's starting center sidelined for summer.

story_log.title: Adrian Rodriguez hits for cycle with 7 RBI to keep Texas alive at College World Series, forces rematch with Georgia
story_log.development: Rodriguez became third player in MCWS history to hit for cycle, posted 7 RBI (tied for most in MCWS game history), 5 hits (tied for most by Texas player in MCWS game). Texas staved off elimination vs Alabama, forces rematch with Georgia. Oklahoma beat Georgia 3-0 in other game. SportsCenter: historic night in Omaha.

story_log.title: Romelu Lukaku scores four seconds after subbing on for Belgium, Egypt equalizes immediately
story_log.development: Lukaku subbed on for Belgium vs Egypt, scored roughly 4 seconds later. Immediately after Lukaku's goal, Egypt scored own goal to equalize 1-1. HaterReport: 'ROMELU LUKAKU SUBS ON FOR BELGIUM AND AN OWN GOAL HAPPENS IMMEDIATELY!' BarstoolReags: 'Gotta be some sort of record there. Lukaku scored roughly 4 seconds after subbing on.' World Cup chaos.

story_log.title: Knicks players continue championship celebration with wild media appearances, including Mikal Bridges drunk on IG Live
story_log.development: Mikal Bridges absolutely plastered on IG Live talking about 10-week sex ban rumor, Jeremy Sochan, ranting about Coldplay. Josh Hart: Brunson only his 'work best friend.' Brunson's toast at team party: 'F**k Wemby.' OG Anunoby smiled on Good Morning America, teammates lost it. KAT on Father's Day: 'I think we good, we got them a trophy.' ClutchPoints and HaterReport captured all moments. NYC still celebrating.

story_log.title: Minnesota Lynx extend win streak to 9 straight without Napheesa Collier, now 10-2 on season
story_log.development: Lynx beat Portland 107-74 for ninth straight win. Minnesota now 10-2 despite Collier not playing a game this season. Jessica Shepard 15-15-9, tied with A'ja and Angel for most 15/15 games this season. Azzi Fudd 19 pts on 8-9 FG vs Vegas (2-0 vs defending champs). StatMuse highlighted dominance.

story_log.title: Dallas Wings stun defending champion Aces 96-66, deny Vegas chance to clinch Commissioner's Cup spot
story_log.development: Wings crushed Aces 96-66 (30-point margin). Snapped Vegas' 6-game win streak. Dallas only team with two wins vs Aces this season. ClutchPoints: 'The Wings STUN A'ja Wilson and the defending champion Aces.' Veronica Burton hit triple after Kayla Thornton steal.

story_log.title: Miguel Rojas pinch-hit go-ahead homer in seventh gives Dodgers 4-3 win over Rays
story_log.development: Rojas entered as pinch-hitter, belted go-ahead homer in 7th to give LA lead. Kyle Tucker tied it earlier with three-run shot. Ryan Vilade two-run homer for Tampa. Dodgers won 4-3. ESPN and ClutchPoints highlighted Rojas' clutch pinch-hit blast.

story_log.title: Eugenio Suarez hits two homers including grand slam, drives in 6 runs as Reds demolish Mets 12-0
story_log.development: Suarez hit 2-run shot in first inning, grand slam in second inning vs Mets (6 RBI total). Cincinnati crushed New York 12-0. StatMuse: 'Hit a 2-run shot in the first and a Grand Slam in the second.' Reds offense explodes.

story_log.title: Zack Wheeler strikes out 9 Marlins in 6 shutout innings as Phillies roll 7-0
story_log.development: Wheeler: 6.0 IP, 2 H, 0 R, 3 BB, 9 SO vs Miami. Phillies won 7-0. StatMuse and TalkinBaseball: 'He has a 2.59 ERA against the Marlins in his career.' Philadelphia cruises.

story_log.title: BIG3's Joe Johnson out for entire 2026 season due to torn patella tendon complications
story_log.development: Detroit Amps star Johnson will miss entire 2026 BIG3 season due to complications from torn patella tendon he sustained last summer per Chris Haynes. BIG3 season starts Saturday at Intuit Dome. Major blow for league.

story_log.title: Darryn Peterson only grants draft visit to No. 1 pick Wizards, snubs rest of lottery teams ahead of June 23 draft
story_log.development: Kansas' Peterson only visited Washington (No. 1 pick), does not plan to grant anyone else a meeting per Shams. Both Peterson and BYU's AJ Dybantsa believe in going No. 1. Dybantsa visited both Wizards and Jazz (No. 2). Teams in lottery taking note of Peterson's decision to only give access to Washington. Shams reported on NBA Today.

story_log.title: Adam Schefter draws NFL-Knicks parallel after Jim Dolan 'called his shot' months before championship
story_log.development: Schefter posted video of Dolan addressing Knicks before playoff run: 'Knicks owner Jim Dolan called his shot.' Dolan told team they would win championship months ago. Knicks delivered. Which NFL owner will call their shot next?

story_log.title: Carolina Hurricanes win Stanley Cup, end 20-year drought with shutout of Vegas Golden Knights in Game 6
story_log.development: Game 6: Carolina won 3-0 in Vegas to clinch Stanley Cup 4-2. Brandon Bussi shutout (22 saves), first goalie with road shutout in clincher since Matt Murray 2017. Jordan Staal named Conn Smythe MVP at 37 (oldest ever). Rod Brind'Amour wins Cup as coach 20 years after winning as player (2006). Nik Ehlers uncontested goal sealed it. Jaccob Slavin won Olympic Gold and Stanley Cup in same year (joins Ken Morrow as only Americans to do so). Eric and Jordan Staal won Cups exactly 20 years apart. Knicks and Hurricanes won titles 24 hours apart, ending 53-year and 20-year droughts respectively. Series over.

story_log.title: Justin Gaethje upsets Ilia Topuria to win undisputed lightweight title at UFC Freedom 250 at the White House
story_log.development: Gaethje defeated previously unbeaten Topuria via TKO (ref stoppage end of R4) at White House South Lawn to win undisputed lightweight championship. Third time's the charm: Gaethje's third undisputed title fight, first win. Topuria's face swollen shut, told doctor he couldn't see but was sent back out. Topuria left octagon on cart, helped by brother. Gaethje nearly broke neck doing celebratory backflip. $825K in bonuses (POTN + FOTN). UFC spent $60M on Freedom 250 production, Dana White said he'll 'never do this again.' Gane KO'd Pereira in co-main (heavyweight debut). Historic night on White House lawn.

story_log.title: Colorado Rockies score franchise-record 23 runs in demolition of Athletics
story_log.development: Rockies scored franchise-record 23 runs in 23-9 win over A's in Las Vegas. Most runs in MLB game since Reds scored 24 in April 2025. Athletics now 0-23 all-time when allowing 20+ runs.

story_log.title: 2026 World Cup: Sweden routs Tunisia 5-1, Ivory Coast scores 89th-minute winner vs New Zealand, Japan-Netherlands ends in classic 2-2 draw
story_log.development: Sweden crushed Tunisia 5-1 (Gyokeres, Isak, Svanberg, Ayari brace with late stunner). Ivory Coast's Amad Diallo scored 90th-minute winner vs New Zealand. Netherlands and Japan played 2-2 thriller (both teams blew leads). Germany destroyed Curaçao. Scotland fans took over Fenway Park for match. Group stage continues.

story_log.title: Jets sign guard Joe Tippmann to 4-year extension, locking up young offensive lineman
story_log.development: New York extended Tippmann (4 years per Rapoport). One of game's top young guards gets paid. Jets locking up core pieces.

story_log.title: Mandatory minicamps open Tuesday for 11 teams including Jets, Bengals, Cowboys
story_log.development: Schefter: Jets, Bengals, Titans, Broncos, Chargers, Cowboys, Commanders, Lions, Falcons, Saints, Bucs all begin mandatory minicamp Tuesday. Final on-field work before training camps open this summer.

story_log.title: North Carolina improves to 2-0 at College World Series, Ole Miss becomes first team eliminated
story_log.development: Tar Heels now 2-0 in Omaha, one win from CWS Finals. UNC made Finals twice before (2006, 2007), lost to Oregon State both times. Ole Miss eliminated first.

story_log.title: West Virginia loses to North Carolina at College World Series after Pat McAfee attends
story_log.development: WVU lost tough night at CWS. McAfee tweeted 'TOUGH NIGHT' and 'UNC's really good at baseball.' Mountaineers will respond.

story_log.title: Scottish World Cup fans take over Fenway Park during Red Sox-Rangers game, chanting for midfielder John McGinn
story_log.development: Tartan Army invaded Fenway during Yankees-Red Sox series (Sunday Night Baseball). Rousing John McGinn chants during game as Connelly Early faced Ezequiel Durán. Jomboy: get Scotland in WBC just so their fans keep showing up. Albert Breer: 'humiliating that best moment at Fenway this year is when Sox game turned into Scottish soccer rally.'

story_log.title: Umpire warns Yankees utility man Jose Caballero for 'intentionally delaying' game
story_log.development: Ump warned Caballero for intentional delay. Jomboy breakdown. Yankees won SNB vs Rangers behind Wyatt Langford's loud start and Ben Rice's go-ahead 9th-inning homer.

story_log.title: Brewers calling up No. 4 prospect Cooper Pratt, 21-year-old shortstop on 8-year $50.75M deal
story_log.development: Milwaukee promoting Pratt per Nightengale. 21-year-old SS signed 8-year $50.75M contract in April. Brewers No. 4 prospect getting MLB shot.

story_log.title: Kevin Durant expressing 'serious' interest in trade to Knicks per parody report
story_log.development: TheNBACentel (parody): Durant expressing 'serious' interest in Knicks trade (Via Sharms Charania). NYC mayor on Knicks winning in his rookie year. Internet having fun with championship euphoria.

story_log.title: Angel Reese extends double-double streak as Atlanta Dream improve to 8-1 when she grabs 10+ rebounds
story_log.development: Reese last five games: 11-10, 18-17, 17-17, 25-9, 15-17. Dream 8-1 this season when she records double-digit rebounds. StatMuse highlighted.

story_log.title: Breanna Stewart posts career-high 7 blocks vs Washington, first player with those numbers since Brittney Griner in 2018
story_log.development: Stewart vs Mystics: 14 PTS, 12 REB, 7 BLK (career-high). First player since Griner 2018 to record that line. Liberty beat Mystics 86-64.

story_log.title: Bobby Witt Jr. only player this season with 75+ hits and 20+ stolen bases
story_log.development: Witt: only player in 2026 with 75+ H and 20+ SB. StatMuse confirmed. Royals star continues elite two-way production.

story_log.title: Nationals' James Wood (23) is youngest player to hit 20 home runs this season
story_log.development: Wood hit 20th homer of season, youngest player to reach 20 HR in 2026. StatMuse highlighted. Washington rookie breaking out.

story_log.title: Paul Skenes posts second 6+ IP, 10+ K start of 2026, matching his entire 2025 total in half a season
story_log.development: Skenes starts with 6+ IP and 10+ SO: 2 in 2026, 0 in 2025, 2 in 2024. StatMuse noted milestone. Pirates ace rolling.

story_log.title: Knicks win first NBA championship in 53 years behind Jalen Brunson's 45-point Finals MVP performance in Game 5
story_log.development: Game 5: Knicks won 94-90 in San Antonio to clinch championship 4-1. Jalen Brunson 45 pts (Finals MVP, 4th player ever with 45-pt closeout game), OG Anunoby clutch defense again, Josh Hart 13-11. Spurs led for 72% of series but lost 4 of 5 games. Knicks overcame 29-point halftime deficit in Game 4, completed 13-game playoff win streak. De'Aaron Fox 7 pts, 3-15 FG, fouled out. Wemby crumbled in fourth quarters all series. NYC erupts in celebration. Series over.

story_log.title: Former 49ers All-Pro defensive lineman Aldon Smith dies at 36
story_log.development: 49ers announced Smith's death Saturday. Six-season NFL career (49ers, Raiders, Cowboys). First-round pick, All-Pro talent derailed by legal troubles and substance issues. Cause of death not released. NFL community mourning.

story_log.title: Cavaliers guard James Harden arrested in Houston, charged with unlawful carrying of weapon
story_log.development: Harden arrested early Saturday morning in Houston, charged with misdemeanor unlawful carrying of weapon. ESPN confirmed. No details on circumstances. Developing story for Cleveland.

story_log.title: Vinicius Jr. rescues Brazil in 1-1 draw vs Morocco, hosts settle for nervy World Cup opener
story_log.development: Brazil opened World Cup with 1-1 draw vs Morocco. Vinicius Jr. scored equalizer after Morocco took early lead. Ancelotti: nerves got better of team in dreadful start. Brazil avoided loss but drew at home. World Cup underway in North America.

story_log.title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto's no-hitter broken on 9th-inning homer after Mookie Betts error ends perfect game
story_log.development: Yamamoto carried perfect game into 8th inning vs White Sox. Betts error ended perfecto. Yamamoto carried no-hitter into 9th, then gave up solo homer. Dodgers won 7-1. Second no-hit bid Yamamoto has lost on 9th-inning homer this season. ERA now 0.84 through 10 starts.

story_log.title: Kelsey Plum and Kahleah Copper become first WNBA opponents with dueling 40-point games in history
story_log.development: Sparks' Plum posted 43 points, Mercury's Copper finished with 41 in Saturday night game. First time opponents have had dueling 40-point games in WNBA history including postseason. LA won in OT 111-102.

story_log.title: Guardians' José Ramírez breaks hamate bone in left hand, likely out through All-Star break
story_log.development: Ramírez broke hamate bone in left hand on swing Saturday vs Tigers. Second time in career with this injury. Seven-time All-Star, 33, expected out until at least August. Guardians won 3-1 but lost Ramírez.

story_log.title: Cubs' Seiya Suzuki exits game with right knee discomfort after awkward landing on catch attempt
story_log.development: Suzuki left Saturday's game vs Giants with right knee discomfort after attempting fourth-inning catch. Told reporters 'wishing it's not a big deal.' Cubs won 6-1. Extent unclear.

story_log.title: Xander Bogaerts hit in head by pitch, Ron Marinaccio later drills Gunnar Henderson in apparent retaliation
story_log.development: Bogaerts hit in head by pitch, left game for precautionary reasons. Padres up big in 9th, Marinaccio then hit Orioles star Henderson with pitch, ejected. Padres won 9-3. Jomboy breakdown pending.

story_log.title: Braves place Spencer Strider on 15-day IL with right elbow inflammation
story_log.development: Atlanta put Strider on IL Saturday with right elbow inflammation. Left start Friday vs Mets early. Will undergo further testing. Major concern after shoulder/elbow soreness.

story_log.title: Indiana Fever upset Connecticut Sun 85-75 behind balanced attack
story_log.development: Fever beat Sun 85-75. No individual stat breakdowns available but Indiana pulled upset over Connecticut. Fever bounce back.

story_log.title: Las Vegas Aces edge Portland Fire 100-97 behind late rally
story_log.development: Aces beat Fire 100-97. Minnesota Lynx also beat Las Vegas Aces 100-97 per ground truth (conflicting data — using ESPN headline). Close game, Aces escape.

story_log.title: Australia shocks Türkiye 2-0 in World Cup opener, joins USMNT atop Group D
story_log.development: Socceroos beat Türkiye 2-0 in World Cup opener. Nestory Irankunda and Connor Metcalfe scored. Australia joins USA atop Group D with 3 points. Türkiye stunned.

story_log.title: Qatar earns first-ever World Cup point with dramatic 1-1 draw vs Switzerland
story_log.development: Qatar scored late goal to earn 1-1 draw vs Switzerland in World Cup's first major upset. Julen Lopetegui-coached side scored historic last-minute goal. 2022 hosts earn first WC point ever.

story_log.title: Georgia beats Texas in heavyweight College World Series opener, elimination game set for Sunday
story_log.development: Joey Volchko and Georgia won heavyweight CWS opener vs Texas. First elimination game of CWS on deck Sunday. Opening round concludes.

story_log.title: Royals LHP Cole Ragans suffers rehab setback, will undergo further testing on elbow
story_log.development: Ragans on IL since May 8 with left elbow impingement, had setback in injury rehab. Will undergo further testing. Major concern for KC rotation.

story_log.title: Rangers place outfielder Evan Carter on 10-day IL with oblique strain
story_log.development: Texas put Carter on IL after he left Friday's game in fourth inning with oblique strain. Rangers losing key outfielder.

story_log.title: Tigers ace Tarik Skubal returns from injury, loses in first start but shows positives
story_log.development: Skubal made first start since April 29, pitched 4.2 innings in 3-1 loss to Guardians. Showed rust but said 'I need to be better, plain and simple.' Two-time reigning Cy Young winner back much faster than expected after bone chip surgery.

story_log.title: Former Raiders WR Henry Ruggs denied parole nearly five years after fatal crash
story_log.development: Nevada Board of Parole denied Ruggs parole nearly five years after he killed woman in car crash. Will have another opportunity before mandatory release in 2027. ESPN reported.

story_log.title: USMNT demolishes Paraguay 4-1 in World Cup opener, Balogun brace and Pulisic brilliance steal the show on home soil
story_log.development: USA opened World Cup with dominant 4-1 win over Paraguay. Folarin Balogun scored twice (2 goals), Christian Pulisic 1 goal + 1 assist. Antonee Robinson also scored. USA led 3-0 at halftime. Paraguay pulled one back, USA cruised. Pulisic subbed at halftime (precautionary). Tim Ream became oldest USMNT player ever in a World Cup at 38. Biggest USMNT World Cup win since 1930 (+3 goal differential). Host nation dominance, Pochettino's attacking masterclass.

story_log.title: Jacob Misiorowski makes MLB history with 15-strikeout Maddux, first ever complete-game shutout with 15+ Ks in under 100 pitches
story_log.development: Misiorowski threw complete-game one-hitter vs Phillies on just 95 pitches, striking out 15 batters (74 strikes). First pitcher in MLB history with 15+ strikeouts in a Maddux (sub-100 pitch shutout). Faced the minimum. Hit 103.7 mph in 9th inning. Brewers beat Phillies 6-0. Most efficient dominant start in MLB history.

story_log.title: Yordan Alvarez hits grand slam AND two-run homer in same inning, joins exclusive club with six-RBI first frame
story_log.development: Alvarez hit grand slam and two-run homer both in first inning vs Royals. Finished 3-5 with 6 RBI in the game. Astros won 10-8. Only a handful of players in MLB history have hit two homers in same inning.

story_log.title: Knicks one win from first title since 1973 after OG Anunoby's tip-in completes historic Game 4 comeback
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 9]: Game 5 Saturday night at MSG. Knicks can clinch first championship since 1973. Series 3-1 after Game 4 comeback from 29-point halftime deficit (largest in Finals history). Wemby told reporters 'Everybody knows we are going to do it' about 3-1 comeback. Fans pelted Wemby with eggs outside hotel after Game 4. Knicks posted record TV ratings (20.9M viewers Game 4, most since 1998). Game 4 generated 3 billion social media views, most viral NBA game ever.

story_log.title: Red Sox demolish Rangers 10-1 behind Ceddanne Rafaela and Wilyer Abreu's matching 3-3, 1 HR, 3 RBI nights
story_log.development: Rafaela and Abreu each went 3-5, 1 HR, 3 RBI in identical stat lines as Boston crushed Texas 10-1. StatMuse highlighted the twin performances. Red Sox offense exploded.

story_log.title: Bo Bichette grand slam and Juan Soto solo shot lead Blue Jays past Yankees 8-5 in Toronto
story_log.development: Bichette hit grand slam, Soto hit solo homer in back-to-back at-bats as Toronto beat Yankees 8-5. TalkinBaseball highlighted both homers. Yankees lose again.

story_log.title: White Sox shock Dodgers 8-2, first-place Chicago continues improbable run in AL Central
story_log.development: Chicago beat Dodgers 8-2. White Sox in first place in AL Central for first time in over four years. StatMuse: Shohei Ohtani not in lineup but avoided IL (left knee inflammation). White Sox resurgence continues.

story_log.title: Spencer Strider exits Braves start with right shoulder and elbow soreness, will undergo imaging
story_log.development: Strider left Friday's game vs Mets in 4th inning with right shoulder and elbow soreness. Will undergo imaging. Major concern for Atlanta. ESPN and TalkinBaseball reported.

story_log.title: Sonia Citron hits buzzer-beater as Mystics edge Toronto Tempo 86-85 in instant classic
story_log.development: Citron's buzzer-beater gave Washington 86-85 win over Tempo. ClutchPoints highlighted shot. Expansion Tempo falls to 0-1 in franchise history.

story_log.title: Golden State Valkyries beat Seattle Storm 76-72 behind balanced attack
story_log.development: Valkyries beat Storm 76-72. Janelle Salaun hit 4 threes in game for Golden State. ESPN game result confirmed.

story_log.title: North Carolina beats Wofford in College World Series opener, West Virginia steals home in first-ever CWS game
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: North Carolina won CWS opener. West Virginia stole home (Armani Guzman, breaking school's single-season SB record with 39th) in first-ever College World Series game in program history. Guzman: first steal of home at CWS since 2000. WVU won, sang Country Roads, Pat McAfee attended. Both games Day 1 of MCWS.

story_log.title: Hurricanes take 3-2 Stanley Cup Finals lead after Game 5 victory, one win from first Cup since 2006
story_log.development: Game 5: Carolina won 4-2 at home to take 3-2 series lead. Jordan Staal scored twice (now six goals in series, most by any player). Brandon Bussi won second straight start, first goalie to win consecutive games this series. Hurricanes can clinch Sunday in Vegas. Series shifts back to Vegas for Game 6.

story_log.title: Knicks complete largest comeback in NBA Finals history to take 3-1 series lead after OG Anunoby's tip-in with 2.2 seconds left
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 8]: Game 4 recap dominates sports discourse. Knicks overcame 29-point halftime deficit (largest in Finals history) to win 107-106 on OG's putback tip-in with 2.2 seconds left. De'Aaron Fox shot layup instead of dribbling out clock, got blocked by OG. NBA L2M report ruled OG's block on Fox a 'Correct No Call.' Wemby threw egg at outside hotel, fans pelted with boos. KAT told fans to crowd Harper on inbound. Game 5 Saturday in NY. Series 3-1 Knicks, one win from first title since 1973.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark and Aliyah Boston become first WNBA teammates ever with 30-point double-doubles in same game
story_log.development: Clark posted 32 pts, 10 ast (third 30/10a game, most in WNBA history — everybody else combined has four). Boston had 34 pts, 12 reb. First teammates in WNBA history with 30-point double-doubles in same game. Fever beat Sky 114-106 in OT. Clark now has three 30/10a games; rest of WNBA history combined has four.

story_log.title: Paige Bueckers explodes for 31 points on 70% shooting as Wings blow out Mercury
story_log.development: Bueckers posted 31 pts, 6 reb, 5 ast on 14-20 FG (70%), 3-5 3PT vs Phoenix. Joins A'ja Wilson as only sophomores with 30/5/5 game on 70+ FG%. Had 24 points in first half alone. Dallas won by double digits.

story_log.title: MLB to question Dodgers team doctor over alleged involvement in Conor McGregor PED use
story_log.development: MLB investigators plan to question Dodgers head doctor Neal ElAttrache after disclosure he supported Conor McGregor's use of performance-enhancing drugs during injury recovery per NY Times. ElAttrache also serves as LA Rams team doctor. NFL didn't return message seeking comment. Major story developing.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani exits Dodgers game with left knee inflammation, called precautionary
story_log.development: Ohtani exited in 7th inning of Thursday's win at Pittsburgh with left knee inflammation. Manager Dave Roberts said move was precautionary. Ohtani homered earlier (13th of season, second straight game with HR). Dodgers won 8-6 but lost Ohtani mid-game.

story_log.title: 2026 World Cup opens with Mexico beating South Africa 2-0, South Korea rallying past Czechia 2-1
story_log.development: World Cup officially began Thursday. Mexico beat South Africa 2-0 in opening match at Mexico City (Raul Jimenez scored first WC goal, emotional moment after skull fracture in 2020 and father's death in March). South Korea rallied from 1-0 down to beat Czechia 2-1 with late goal. USMNT opens Friday vs Paraguay. Tournament underway across North America.

story_log.title: Broncos reward Sean Payton with new 5-year contract through 2030 after AFC Championship run
story_log.development: Denver signed Payton to new five-year deal through 2030 per Schefter. Payton led Broncos to third-most wins in NFL over past two years including AFC Championship Game appearance last season. Had two years left on old deal, now locked in through 2030. GM George Paton also under contract through 2030. Broncos paying for stability after 8-10-14 win progression under Payton.

story_log.title: Seahawks unveil Super Bowl LX championship rings with tribute to fans, city, and history
story_log.development: Seattle officially presented Super Bowl LX rings at private ceremony Thursday night. Rings feature diamonds, sapphires, team mantras, tribute to 12th Man fans. Schefter and ESPN covered unveiling. Seahawks celebrating first championship.

story_log.title: Former Raiders WR Henry Ruggs denied parole nearly five years after fatal crash
story_log.development: Nevada Board of Parole Commissioners denied parole for Ruggs nearly five years after he killed woman in car crash in Las Vegas. Ruggs will have another opportunity before mandatory parole release date in 2027. CBS Sports and ESPN reported.

story_log.title: Texas Tech releases 21-minute video defending Brendan Sorsby reinstatement, Big 12 weighs sanctions
story_log.development: Texas Tech officials released 20+ minute video defending integrity and support for Sorsby amid widespread criticism from Big 12 and college sports. Texas AG Ken Paxton warned Big 12 of $200M antitrust exposure if league punishes TTU. Trial set for February (two weeks after CFP National Championship). Big 12 weighing sanctions. CBS Sports: explanation can't escape tension between care and competitive incentive.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson becomes fastest WNBA player to 6,000 career points, passes Brittney Griner on all-time scoring list
story_log.development: Wilson posted 32 pts, 5 reb, 2 blk vs Portland to pass Griner on W's all-time scoring leaderboard. Reached 6K points in just 278 games, fastest ever. Chelsea Gray tied WNBA single-game three-point record with 9 threes (29 points). Aces beat Fire.

story_log.title: Nikita Kucherov wins second Hart Trophy as NHL MVP after 130-point season
story_log.development: Kucherov won second Hart Memorial Trophy per SportsCenter. Posted 44 goals, 86 assists, 130 points, +43 in 2025-26 season. Beat out Connor McDavid and Nathan MacKinnon. Lightning star secures second MVP award.

story_log.title: Former NFL linebacker Darron Lee indicted on murder charge in death of partner
story_log.development: Lee indicted on murder charge in death of his partner per AP and Schefter. No foul play suspected initially, but now facing murder charge. Former first-round pick (Jets, Chiefs, 49ers) in serious legal trouble.

story_log.title: Knicks complete largest comeback in NBA Finals history, beat Spurs in Game 4 to take 3-1 series lead after overcoming 29-point deficit
story_log.development: Game 4: Knicks trailed 76-49 at halftime (29-point deficit, largest halftime lead by road team in non-bubble Finals history), then stormed back to win 107-106 on OG Anunoby's putback tip-in with seconds remaining. Largest comeback in NBA Finals history. OG also blocked De'Aaron Fox's layup attempt seconds earlier (Fox chose to shoot instead of dribbling out clock). Jalen Brunson 36 pts (13 in 4th), OG 33 pts on 10-15 FG, 7-9 3PT, Dylan Harper 21 pts (youngest 20-pt Finals game ever). Spurs scored 76 in first half, 30 in second half (46-point swing ties largest in playoff history per ESPN). Series 3-1 Knicks, one win from first title in 53 years.

story_log.title: Spurs author biggest single-game choke in NBA Finals history as De'Aaron Fox and Wembanyama crumble in second half
story_log.development: Fox shot layup with 10 seconds left instead of dribbling out clock, got blocked by OG, leading to OG's game-winning tip. Fox postgame: 'I just thought I'd be able to outrun OG.' Wemby told Mitch Robinson 'I'm in your head' early in game, then went 4-18 FG after that moment with multiple missed clutch free throws. Spurs 14-26 3PT, 12-19 paint FG, 2 turnovers first half; then 3-17 3PT, 2-14 paint FG, 10 turnovers second half. Chuck: 'dumbest basketball team in history of civilization.' Mike Brown: moment too big for them. Federal officials reportedly pulled Mitch Johnson aside for interrogation per parody account.

story_log.title: Giants rookie Bryce Eldridge hits walk-off grand slam to cap comeback MLB hasn't seen in 17 years, breaks Roberto Clemente record
story_log.development: Giants trailed Nationals 10-1 entering 8th inning, scored 5 in 8th and 5 in 9th including Eldridge's walk-off grand slam to win 11-10. First team to win after trailing by 9+ runs entering 8th since 2009. Eldridge put himself in MLB record books with one swing per CBS Sports (broke record held by Roberto Clemente). Matt Chapman went 5-for-5 earlier in series with 8 RBI, Eldridge continues Giants' rookie power surge.

story_log.title: Toronto Tempo wins franchise debut in overtime behind Brittney Sykes' 38-point explosion
story_log.development: Tempo beat Connecticut 106-102 in OT in first game in franchise history. Sykes posted 38 pts (career-high tie) on 11-20 FG, 13-13 FT. Expansion team starts 1-0. Connecticut remains winless to start season.

story_log.title: Patrick Mahomes becomes NFL's first half-billion-dollar player with contract extension through 2033
story_log.development: Chiefs and Mahomes agreed to add two years to his contract, tying him to Kansas City through 2033 at total value of $504.75M (first NFL deal over half-billion dollars). Will earn NFL-best $64M per year. Deal negotiated by Equity Sports CEO Chris Cabott and Brett Veach. Mahomes cap numbers: $8.84M (2026), $15M (2027), $27.6M (2028), $39.9M (2029), $48.2M (2030), then another $39.9M after 2031 void. StatMuse: '$64M per year. The most in NFL history.'

story_log.title: Dolphins sign center Aaron Brewer to $52.5M extension, making him one of NFL's highest-paid centers
story_log.development: Miami extended Brewer (3 years, $52.5M, $37M guaranteed) making him one of highest-paid centers in league per Schefter. Went from undrafted free agent to finalist for NFL Protector of the Year Award last season. Dolphins now have two recent extensions: RB De'Von Achane (4 years, $64M) and Brewer.

story_log.title: Jose Siri walks off Astros as Angels complete late rally
story_log.development: Siri hit walk-off for Angels to beat Astros 3-2. TalkinBaseball: 'Hey Siri, show us a walk-off!' Mike Trout homered earlier (15th of season). Angels beat Houston in comeback fashion.

story_log.title: Rockies walk off Cubs after TJ Rumfield gives Colorado late lead
story_log.development: Rumfield put Rockies ahead late, Ian Happ tied it in 9th with homer, then Rockies walked it off vs Cubs. Colorado won 3-2. Cubs bullpen meltdown continues per W_B_Rick.

story_log.title: Pirates rookie Tyler Callihan homers twice including go-ahead blast off Shohei Ohtani
story_log.development: Callihan hit first career homer off Ohtani (466 feet) then hit go-ahead homer in 8th to give Pirates lead over Dodgers. Joins Christian Walker and Braden Shewmake as only players to homer off Ohtani this season. Ohtani's ERA rose to 1.00 for first time this season (was 0.84). Pirates fans ecstatic. CespedesBBQ: 'Where were you for the Tyler Callihan Game?'

story_log.title: Jackson Holliday breaks open Orioles-Mariners game with grand slam
story_log.development: Holliday hit grand slam vs Mariners (4 RBI total). One of only 7 players to hit grand slam in each of last three seasons per StatMuse. Baltimore beat Seattle 7-2. Brandon Young gave O's 7 shutout innings.

story_log.title: White Sox beat Braves to take sole possession of first place in AL Central for first time in over four years
story_log.development: Chicago beat Atlanta 2-1. First time White Sox in sole possession of first in AL Central since over four years ago per TalkinBaseball. Braden Montgomery's debut walk-off from June 10 launching resurgent season.

story_log.title: Max Scherzer becomes 11th pitcher in MLB history to record 3,500 career strikeouts
story_log.development: Scherzer struck out former teammate Kyle Schwarber to reach 3,500 K milestone. 11th pitcher in MLB history to do so per StatMuse. Rangers-Phillies game.

story_log.title: Missouri Senator Eric Schmitt goes all out for catch at Congressional Baseball Game, leaves with blood on nose
story_log.development: 50-year-old Schmitt laid out for catch at 2026 Congressional Baseball Game, left with blood on his nose. Jomboy Media highlighted. Democrats won game.

story_log.title: Packers TE Tucker Kraft expects to start Week 1 with no restrictions after torn ACL
story_log.development: Kraft said he anticipates playing Week 1 without pitch count after tearing ACL last season per Rob Demovsky. Expects to start with no restrictions. Packers getting key weapon back.

story_log.title: Deion Sanders announces he is 'cancer-free' heading into Year 4 at Colorado
story_log.development: Sanders announced he is cancer-free and thankful to be healthy heading into 2026 season per CBS Sports. Buffaloes coach back to full strength for Year 4.

story_log.title: Hurricanes tie Stanley Cup Finals 2-2 with Game 4 victory behind rookie goalie Brandon Bussi's 18-save playoff debut
story_log.development: Game 4: Carolina won 5-3 in Vegas to tie series 2-2, knocking around Vegas' backup goaltender after starter went down. Rookie Brandon Bussi got first career playoff start, posted 18 saves. Jordan Staal scored twice (five goals in series, most by any player). Series tied heading back to Raleigh for Game 5.

story_log.title: Braden Montgomery hits walk-off home run in MLB debut, only fifth player ever to do so
story_log.development: White Sox prospect Montgomery became fifth player in MLB history to hit walk-off homer in debut, two years and one day after breaking his ankle in College World Series super regional with Texas A&M. Bob Costas on call. Chicago's resurgent season continues.

story_log.title: Olivia Miles (No. 2 pick) improves to 2-0 vs Azzi Fudd (No. 1 pick) as Lynx extend win streak to eight
story_log.development: Miles posted 24 pts, 7 reb, 6 ast on 7-10 FG vs Fudd's 6 pts, 2 stl on 2-12 FG, 2-6 3PT as Minnesota blew out Dallas 100-76. Lynx now 10-2 despite Napheesa Collier not playing a game this season. Miles continues rookie dominance.

story_log.title: Messi makes cameo appearance in front of 88,043 at Auburn as Argentina beats Iceland in World Cup warmup
story_log.development: Argentina played Iceland in front of sold-out crowd of 88,043 at Auburn, Alabama. Messi subbed on to massive roar. Crowd reaction and stadium atmosphere went viral. American universities hosting World Cup build-up friendlies. Tournament opens Friday.

story_log.title: Angel Reese posts 17-17 in return to Chicago, puts on crown after beating former squad
story_log.development: Reese had 17 pts, 17 reb, 2 stl, +18 vs Sky in Atlanta's 82-75 win. Put on crown after game. Dream improve record when she gets double-digit rebounds. First time back in Chicago since trade.

story_log.title: Freddie Freeman becomes only active player with 2,500 career hits
story_log.development: Freeman reached 2,500 career hits vs Pirates, only active player in that club. TalkinBaseball highlighted milestone. Dodgers rallied late after Paul Skenes exited 2-2, scoring four in seventh.

story_log.title: Ronald Acuña Jr. exits game after apparent injury running to first base, diagnosed with left hamstring tightness
story_log.development: Acuña exited Braves-White Sox game in mid-innings after suffering injury running to first base. Braves later announced left hamstring tightness. Extent unclear. Atlanta won game with Matt Olson's two-homer performance.

story_log.title: Dodgers' Dalton Rushing called for interference on slide that hasn't been legal for 10 years
story_log.development: Rushing slid hard into second base in way that rule changes outlawed a decade ago, was called for interference. Jomboy and SleeperHQ highlighted. Dodgers-Pirates game.

story_log.title: Gerrit Cole late covering first one inning after YES broadcasters said he wouldn't make 2024 World Series mistake again
story_log.development: Cole was late covering first base one inning after Yankees broadcasters said he wouldn't repeat his 2024 World Series debacle. Jomboy breakdown went viral. Yankees beat Guardians 3-2.

story_log.title: NBA admits Victor Wembanyama fouled Jalen Brunson with Game 3 shove but won't upgrade to flagrant, Trump unlikely to attend Game 4
story_log.development: NBA admitted Wemby's shove to Brunson's head was a foul but will not upgrade to flagrant, keeping Wemby at two flagrant points. Trump not expected at Game 4 Wednesday at MSG due to scheduling conflicts per Shams. Series 2-1 Knicks after Spurs' Game 3 win Monday.

story_log.title: Spurs stay alive with Game 3 win as Knicks' 13-game playoff win streak ends at Madison Square Garden
story_log.development: Game 3: Spurs won 115-111 at MSG, ending Knicks' 13-game playoff win streak (second-longest in NBA history). Wemby 32-8-6 on 11-18 FG, Stephon Castle 23-5-5 (clutch FTs and late 3). Knicks trailed by 12 in 2nd half, got within 2 points in final minute. Series 2-1 Knicks. Trump attended, fell asleep during game. Enhanced security caused long waits. Game 4 Wednesday in NY.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark hits first WNBA game-winner, 31-foot logo three with 1.2 seconds left for Indiana
story_log.development: Clark banked in 31-foot three-pointer with 1.2 seconds remaining to beat Mystics 78-76, her first game-winner in WNBA career. Came after missing crucial free throws earlier. Indiana avoided another loss with Clark's clutch shot. CBS Sports called it a rough stretch for Fever before Clark delivered.

story_log.title: Athletics play first home game in Las Vegas, Brewers and A's combine for 29 runs in 15-14 thriller
story_log.development: A's played first 6-game homestand at Las Vegas Ballpark (temporary home while new stadium is built). Brewers won 15-14 in 10 innings. Shea Langeliers hit leadoff homer on first pitch. Nick Kurtz homered twice (down to final strike in 9th). Jonah Heim pinch-hit homer tied it 14-14 in 10th. William Contreras hit ball 463 feet. Kyle Harrison allowed 7 runs including first HR to LHH this season. Balls flying in Vegas.

story_log.title: Cody Bellinger delivers go-ahead two-run single in 10th as Yankees beat Guardians 7-5
story_log.development: Yankees trailed 5-3, Angel Martinez hit go-ahead two-run homer in 9th to give Cleveland lead, then Bellinger's two-run single in 10th gave Yankees 7-5 win. Mariners pitcher Matt Brash nearly hit Taylor Ward and Pete Alonso in head three times in separate game (Jomboy breakdown). Aaron Judge still dealing with shoulder soreness/bone bruise.

story_log.title: Mike Brown rips NBA Finals officiating after Spurs' Game 3 win: 'I never thought I'd see 24 FTs to 8 in a half'
